item.content:encoded:
See feedback below.

Feel free
to keep your downvote

1: Valid, ammended.

2: I understand the extra commas aren't needed. However, technically it is not considered incorrect (You mean before "which" and after "all"?). Since this spoiled an article for you, however, I have removed one of them.

3: I admit, "mixture" works better.

4: Hyphenating? This was a major issue for you? Okay, fixed.

5: The point of the collapsible is to show how the skip was discovered, which is the context I chose to use in that sentence. Not an error.

6: It was not discovered by "those LiveFeel people". The anomaly created an oppurtunity for LiveFeel to exist. They did not discover it, they are a result of it. Guateng is very far from KwaZulu-Natal. The Foundation theorized the origin themselves, using interrogations and tracking the spread of reports on this anomaly.

From the article:

After a short investigation involving host interrogation, the origin of SCP-4969 was traced to Gauteng, a major city in the country.

Using information received from undercover agents posing as civilians interested in SCP-4969, Foundation agents infiltrated and destroyed multiple locations producing SCP-4969 and, in the process, discovered the following notable details:

  • The SCP-4969 organism is theorized to have originated from the coastal area of KwaZulu-Natal. However, no wild SCP-4969 instances have been found since its discovery.

Therefore, theorized.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
1: Gelatinous Zooplankton is capitalized for some reason? So is "Affected?"
2. natural death after 12 hours, after which, all bonds are severed (not needed comma after "which" and "all"
3. with a concoction of chemicals: "concoction" doesn't sound very formal, "mixture" would be a better term
4. an above average drop: above-average not above average
5. produce what is now known to be SCP-4969. Replace "what is now known to be" with "instances of"
6. "The SCP-4969 organism is theorized to have originated from the coastal area of KwaZulu-Natal. However, no wild SCP-4969 instances have been found since its discovery." If it was discovered by those LiveFeel people, it wouldn't be a theory, would it? It's not "we think we found these on the beach" it's "we found these on the beach"

And that's when I gave up.
